test_title: PYST 20: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 7 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing ‘1’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd3f7f186179cf011676266b84dc554ce9bcb37fd4f114ed3add8b01539f0976.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f3a18474b1550ccb72c19126126af4e5c54ede1137f3d45bbf06f4b6bf48b1a.png] 

2 and 5 are common in both the dices.

Clearly, **6 will be on the face opposite to the number 1.**

Hence, **'option 3'** is the correct answer.
